Block-Paving Driveways in Ruislip and North West London

Why choose block paving?

Block paving is one of the most popular choices for driveways in North West London, and for good reason:

  • Hard-wearing – a properly laid block-paved driveway copes with daily parking for years.
  • Looks smart – a choice of colours and laying patterns lets you match the style of your home [PLACEHOLDER: confirm range of colours/patterns offered].
  • Easy to repair – if a block is ever damaged, it can be lifted and replaced without redoing the whole drive.
  • Adds value – a tidy, well-designed driveway improves how your home looks from the street.

We use quality materials, including Marshalls bricks, so your driveway looks good and lasts.

How we build your driveway

  1. Free visit and quote

    We look at the space, talk through what you want and give you a clear, no-obligation quote.

  2. Planning the design

    We agree the shape, pattern and colours with you before work starts.

  3. Preparing the ground

    The old surface is removed and the ground is dug out and prepared so the new driveway has a solid base.

  4. Laying the blocks

    The blocks are laid carefully to the agreed pattern, with neat edges and cuts.

  5. Finishing and tidy-up

    We finish the surface, clear the site and walk you through the result.

Planning your new driveway

Every home is different, so it helps to think about a few things early:

  • How many cars you want to park, and whether you want to keep part of the front garden.
  • Access from the road – if you need a new or wider dropped kerb, this usually needs approval from your local council (for example Hillingdon, Harrow, Brent, Barnet or Watford). We can talk you through it [PLACEHOLDER: confirm what help you offer with dropped-kerb applications].
  • Planning rules – some front-garden paving and properties in conservation areas have extra rules. We will mention anything to check during your free visit [PLACEHOLDER: confirm planning wording].

Driveway FAQs

How much does a new block-paving driveway cost?

It depends on the size of the area, the current surface, access and the design you choose. The best way to get an accurate price is a free, no-obligation quote. We visit, measure up and give you a clear price.

How long does it take to lay a driveway?

Most driveways take a few days, depending on size and the ground underneath [PLACEHOLDER: confirm typical driveway duration]. We will give you a timescale with your quote.

Do I need permission for a new driveway?

If you need a new or wider dropped kerb, you will usually need approval from your local council. Some front-garden paving and homes in conservation areas also have extra planning rules. We will flag anything to check during your visit [PLACEHOLDER: confirm planning wording].

Is your work guaranteed?

Yes. All our driveways come with our guarantee [PLACEHOLDER: confirm guarantee length and terms].

Do you give free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and there is no obligation.
